reuse.why: Selects categories with the existing getMonthFillCategories and FILL_RULES, converts the sign with averageToBudget, and reads spending with getSheetValue like the other actions.

duplication.why: No selection or sign logic is re-implemented; the new action is a thin composition of existing helpers.

placement.why: Action lives in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) beside the other month-wide methods.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short, readable and automatically follows any change to the shared month-wide category rules.
